description: This file defines a React functional component named Header, responsible for rendering the application's header bar, managing user authentication interactions (login/logout), and displaying user information and app details.

methods.name: fetchMe
methods.description: Fetches current user data and updates state; called on component mount and after login.

methods.name: onLogin
methods.description: Handles user login process, updates user state upon success.

methods.name: onLogout
methods.description: Logs out the user, clears auth token and user data.
